courses.title: Class-A Highlight Surgery
courses.objective: Find a surface flaw with zebra stripes and curvature combs, fix its cause at the section curve, then match two panels from G0 up to G3.

steps.title: Panel A
steps.learn: A smooth first panel, lofted through three sections and rebuilt to 8 × 8.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch three XZ sections at Y 0, 30 and 60.
steps.why: Panel A is the reference: it is already fair.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Panel B with a flaw
steps.learn: Panel B is lofted the same way, but its middle section has a small bump at X = 90.
instructions: Sketch three sections for B at X 70 to 130.
The middle one rises 4 mm too high at X = 90.
steps.why: A tiny defect in one section curve is enough to ruin the highlights.

checkpoint.expected: A second panel with a hidden kink.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Look with zebra
steps.learn: Zebra stripes reveal what the shape hides.
steps.why: The stripes bend where the surface has a bump.

checkpoint.expected: Stripes that wobble on panel B.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Match at G0
steps.learn: Match B to A at position only. They touch, but the highlights break.
instructions: NURBS+ › Match: B to A, G0.
steps.why: G0 only guarantees the edges meet.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Show the curvature comb
steps.learn: The comb shows curvature along the surface.
steps.why: The comb on B shows a pinch exactly where the bump is.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Try G1
steps.learn: Tangent continuity removes the crease at the joint.
steps.why: Changing the continuity does not fix a flawed section.

checkpoint.expected: A tangent joint, but the bump remains.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Fix the cause
steps.learn: The flaw is in the section curve, not the match. Correct the middle section of B.
instructions: Lower the middle point to the smooth line.
steps.why: Always fix the source, not the symptom.

checkpoint.expected: The bump disappears from the zebra and the comb.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: G2 match
steps.learn: Curvature continuity makes the highlight flow across the joint.
steps.why: G2 is what a class-A surface needs across a joint.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: G3 match
steps.learn: Match the rate of change of curvature.
steps.why: G3 gives the smoothest possible highlights; it matters on reflective, visible surfaces.

checkpoint.expected: The best continuity the tool offers.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Deviation check
steps.learn: Measure how far B has moved to meet A.
steps.why: Every match moves a surface: check the movement is within tolerance.

checkpoint.expected: A deviation readout for the matched panel.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Scan to NURBS: Deviation Budget
courses.objective: Fit a NURBS surface to a noisy scan, watch the deviation, tune the point count, trim the ragged edge and turn it into a clean solid.

steps.title: The scan
steps.learn: A synthetic point cloud stands in for a scanner: 650 noisy points on a gently wavy surface.
instructions: NURBS+ › Import points (or use this synthetic cloud).
steps.why: Real scans are noisy; the fit has to average the noise out, not copy it.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: First fit: too coarse
steps.learn: Fit a 5 × 5 surface. It follows the trend but misses the detail.
steps.why: Start coarse; the deviation will tell you whether it is enough.

checkpoint.expected: A smooth surface under the points.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Show the deviation
steps.learn: Colour the points by their distance from the surface.
steps.why: The deviation report is your quality number: RMS and maximum.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: More control points
steps.learn: Increase to 9 × 9 and watch the deviation fall.
steps.why: More points fit better, up to the point where you start fitting the noise.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Stiffer smoothing
steps.learn: Raise the smoothing to ignore the noise.
steps.why: Smoothing trades deviation for fairness: pick the balance your tolerance allows.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: More refinement passes
steps.learn: Iterations re-project the points and refine the fit.
steps.why: Each pass reassigns points to the nearest surface position.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Trim the ragged edge
steps.learn: Scans are poorly defined near the boundary. Trim to a clean rectangle inside the data.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch a rectangle 100 × 70 on the XY plane.
steps.why: Never trust the outer 5 % of a scan.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Zebra check
steps.learn: Check the surface quality before turning it into a solid.
steps.why: Straight, even stripes mean good curvature continuity.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Give it thickness
steps.learn: Offset the surface into a solid sheet.
steps.why: A closed solid can be machined, printed or checked in analysis.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Dashboard Panel with Vent Slots
courses.objective: Cut vent slots and a speaker grille into a domed dashboard panel with projected trims, untrim and retrim, then offset and thicken it.

steps.title: Panel sections
steps.learn: The panel is a gentle dome, 160 mm wide and 60 mm deep.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch three XZ sections at Y −30, 0 and 30.
The middle one is 9 mm higher than the outer two.
steps.why: A domed panel makes the trim projection visible.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loft and rebuild
steps.learn: Loft through the sections and rebuild to a clean net.
steps.why: A rebuilt surface trims more reliably than a raw loft.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Slot outlines
steps.learn: Three rounded slots are sketched flat on the XY plane.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch three rectangles 30 × 8 at X −50, 0, 50.
steps.why: Draw the slots flat. They are projected onto the panel in the next step.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Trim the slots
steps.learn: Project the three rectangles along Z and cut them out.
instructions: NURBS+ › Trim: project along Z, keep outside.
steps.why: One trim cuts every loop in the sketch.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Speaker grille
steps.learn: Twelve small circles make a grille at each end.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch 12 circles of radius 3 in two rows on each side.
steps.why: Many small loops in one sketch are one trim feature.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Trim the grille
steps.learn: One more trim cuts all twelve holes.
instructions: NURBS+ › Trim: project along Z, keep outside.
steps.why: Each trim feature is stored in history, so you can reorder it or remove it later.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Untrim
steps.learn: Untrim restores the surface to its untrimmed boundary.
steps.why: Trimming never destroys the surface, so you can always restore it.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Retrim with slots only
steps.learn: Trim again, using only the slots.
instructions: NURBS+ › Trim: keep outside, using the slot sketch only.
steps.why: Retrimming lets you change your mind without redrawing anything.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Zebra check
steps.learn: Check the highlights around the slots before thickening.
steps.why: Trimming should not disturb the surface quality. Check it now, while the surface is still a surface.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Offset the panel
steps.learn: Offset the trimmed panel 3 mm downward as a copy for the inner skin.
steps.why: Offset keeps trims, so the slots appear in the copy too.

checkpoint.expected: A second panel under the first.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Thicken the panel
steps.learn: Turn the panel into a 2 mm solid.
steps.why: A solid dashboard panel can be sectioned and checked.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

courses.title: Degree & Knots Lab
courses.objective: See what degree, knots and control points do to the same surface: raise the degree, insert and remove knots, then rebuild.

steps.title: Three section curves
steps.learn: A surface is lofted through three curves at different positions.
instructions: NURBS › Sketch on XZ planes at Y −35, 0 and 35.
Each is a fit-point spline with five points.
steps.why: The curves are the data; the degree and knot vector are how the maths interprets them.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Loft at degree 2
steps.learn: Degree 2 gives a quadratic surface through the sections.
instructions: NURBS › Loft, pick the three sketches, degree 2.
steps.why: Lower degree means fewer control points and a less smooth surface.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Raise the degree
steps.learn: Elevating the degree in U adds control points but does not change the shape.
steps.why: Degree elevation is exact: it changes the maths, not the geometry.

checkpoint.expected: A surface of the same shape with a higher degree.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Insert a knot in U
steps.learn: A knot adds a row of control points exactly where you ask for it.
instructions: NURBS+ › Add knot (surface): direction U, at 0.37.
steps.why: Inserting knots is how you add editing resolution without changing the shape.

checkpoint.expected: One more column of control points.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Insert a knot in V
steps.learn: The same in the other direction.
steps.why: Each direction has its own knot vector.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Remove knots
steps.learn: Remove knots within a tolerance: the shape stays within 0.01 mm but points disappear.
instructions: NURBS+ › Remove knot: direction U, automatic, tolerance 0.01.
steps.why: Removal is approximate. Always set a tolerance and check the result.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Rebuild to a clean grid
steps.learn: Rebuild resamples the surface onto a regular 6 × 6 grid of degree 3.
instructions: NURBS › Rebuild: 6 × 6 points, degree 3 in both directions.
steps.why: A uniform, low-degree surface is what you want to hand to downstream CAD.
steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".

steps.title: Curvature comb
steps.learn: Check the result with the curvature comb: it should be smooth.
steps.why: A comb that wiggles means the surface has too many or too few control points.

checkpoint.expected: Comb teeth drawn along the surface.

steps.recovery: Press Ctrl+Z, then repeat this step with exactly the values listed under "Aakar will build".
